source_use: Patterns only. No downloaded source text, source contract, real party identity or real pricing is included. Fictional commitments are deliberately distinct.
uploaded_reference: User-supplied redacted SOW reviewed locally for framework/order/SOW hierarchy, service scope, deliverables, resources, charges, change control and approval structure. Pricing was redacted, SLA schedule absent and personnel counts inconsistent across sections; none were inferred or copied as fact.
deck_traceability: Reviewed the supplied vendor decision architecture deck, source domains slide 6, and the 12-slide business story, connected evidence slide 3. Six classes group identity/ownership together and retain history as version metadata across all classes.

web_sources.used_for: Measurement windows, explicit exclusions, claim evidence and credit-basis concepts. Numeric commitments and clauses were invented.
Separate service schedules alongside core commercial terms. No schedule wording reproduced.
Configuration-item and application/service dependency separation. Invented IDs and relationships.
Business impact and continuity planning concepts. Fictional recovery targets and procedures.

format_research.concept: Fixed-price scope and allocation of delivery cost risk; no regulatory applicability asserted
Hourly role rates, evidence and ceiling controls for T&M
Backlog evolution, sprint acceptance and commercial alignment
Front sheet, core terms and modular service schedules

adaptation_note: Reference SOW is inspiration only. Ten fictional document families combine researched commercial structures with original SaaS, research, unit-service and training adaptations. No claim that every family reproduces an official template.
